product_one_liner.value: AmplifAI unifies contact-center data and uses AI to deliver analytics, automated QA, coaching, performance management, and CX insights for enterprise contact centers and global BPOs.
product_one_liner.notes: The platform overview says AmplifAI consolidates contact-center data and provides role-specific insights and actions, including analytics, QA, coaching, performance management, and CX tools for enterprise contact centers and global BPOs.

pricing_page.notes: The official homepage directs visitors to request a demo, and the company’s demo page is a lead-capture/scheduling page rather than public pricing; no public pricing page was found.

employee_band.notes: Available company headcount records report 168 and 170 employees, both of which fall in the 101–200 band. Headcount sources are estimates, so confidence is medium.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: AmplifAI’s own About page labels the Plano office its headquarters and gives its Plano, Texas address. | hq_country: The company profile places AmplifAI in Plano, United States, identifying the country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: AmplifAI’s earlier first-party account says its founder started the company in 2016. A later fundraising page has also described its founding as 2018, so the conflicting company histories make this a medium-confidence selection.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index categorizes the publication around coaching, learning, buyer guides, CX/industry content, company news, and press; it does not show a technical engineering blog with at least two build-focused posts.

public_docs.notes: The public AmplifAI 101 resource contains ten posts explaining how the product unifies contact-center data, automates QA, and scales coaching; however, this is a learning/resource hub rather than an actual product documentation or developer portal, so it does not meet the requested definition.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers page lists a Senior .Net Full Stack Developer opening and no AI, ML, or data-science title.
